blocks.text: I can’t recommend an award itinerary for SFO–BKK in January: the results contain award-search summaries, but no complete eligible journeys with flight schedules. So there’s no verified end-to-end award option to compare on actual departure, arrival, or connection timing.

As a separate cash baseline, the Jan 1 search returned five SFO–BKK itineraries. The lowest displayed fare is $640, but its trip takes 44 hours 40 minutes and arrives in Bangkok on Jan 4. A $958 option arrives on Jan 2 at 11:05 p.m. after 20 hours 20 minutes; it saves more than a day, but leaves at 11:45 a.m. on Jan 1. These are dated quotes, not live fares, and their price scope is unknown, so don’t treat them as a confirmed party total or assume a per-person price.

blocks.text: There are direct-route award leads for Jan 1 in economy: Aeroplan at 65,000 points, United at 60,500, and Alaska at 42,500. The Alaska quote is the lowest points figure among these three, but the programs’ points are separate currencies and shouldn’t be compared as interchangeable value. These entries do not include flight times, arrival dates, or a complete flight sequence, so none establishes an itinerary or a booking-ready alternative.

A materially different possibility appears if you can position to Taipei: a Dec 31 TPE–BKK summary shows business class, while another summary for that same route and date is economy. But Dec 31 is before your January departure window, these are only segment summaries, and they do not establish a workable SFO-to-BKK trip. A separate SFO–TPE award summary exists for Jan 1, but combining it with a Taipei–Bangkok segment would require verifying the schedules and arranging the connection; the evidence does not show a protected connection. The displayed seat counts and prices also do not establish that all required segments can be booked together.
Business-class TPE–BKK lead, dated before the requested window.

blocks.text: The award observations were recorded on Oct 9, 2026, rather than checked in real time. Their award prices have unknown scope, and summaries alone do not verify current availability, schedules, connectivity, or bookability. The Taipei route is therefore a possible search direction—not a confirmed substitute for the requested SFO–BKK journey.
